about: For incident.meteorology@ (which maps where each site's data comes from and under what licence): every entry of sites.json with what the site itself says about its data and models, where we read it ('stated': null = we did not read a page of the site that says), its API line, our licence line, and the links to its terms and contact pages as printed. This file is the hand-over; the lineage itself is not kept here.

sites.name: Met Office (UK)
sites.api: Weather DataHub (site-specific, map images, atmospheric models); key needed; plans by daily request limit
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: Crown copyright; website material under the UK Open Government Licence v3.0 unless marked; some data licensed for a fee
sites.reuse: yes with attribution for OGL material

sites.name: US National Weather Service
sites.api: api.weather.gov: JSON-LD/GeoJSON, alerts in CAP, no key (a User-Agent is asked for)
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: US government work: public domain (third-party imagery excepted)

sites.name: US National Hurricane Center
sites.api: RSS and GIS feeds (shapefile, KML) per storm; text products

sites.name: Deutscher Wetterdienst (Germany)
sites.stated: Its own models (ICON), radar network and stations (its open-data server was listed; model names from Open-Meteo's licence page).
sites.api: opendata.dwd.de: files over HTTPS, no key (GRIB, BUFR, CAP, CSV)
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: CC BY 4.0 with source named (read on its legal notice)

sites.name: Météo-France: Vigilance
sites.api: meteo.data.gouv.fr and a public API portal (key needed)
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: French open licence (Etalab) for public data; not re-read in this pass

sites.name: AEMET (Spain)
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: reuse allowed citing AEMET as the source, without distorting the information (read on its legal notice)

sites.name: Yr (MET Norway and NRK)
sites.owner: Norwegian Meteorological Institute and NRK (public broadcaster)
sites.stated: MET Norway's forecasts (credit asked: "The Norwegian Meteorological Institute"); the warnings shown for Lisbon are IPMA's. Which model feeds the Lisbon rows was not stated on the page read.
sites.api: api.met.no (Locationforecast and others): JSON, no key, an identifying User-Agent required
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: NLOD 2.0 and CC BY 4.0; credit MET Norway (read on its licence page)

sites.name: KNMI (Netherlands)
sites.stated: Its own stations and the HARMONIE-AROME model (read on the KNMI Data Platform listing).
sites.api: KNMI Data Platform: Open Data API, EDR API, notification service (key needed)
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: CC BY 4.0 on the datasets read

sites.name: SMHI (Sweden)
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: CC BY 4.0 (not re-read in this pass)

sites.name: Finnish Meteorological Institute
sites.api: WFS open data, no key for most
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: CC BY 4.0 (read on its licence page)

sites.name: Japan Meteorological Agency
sites.api: JSON behind the map, undocumented but stable; XML feeds
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: government terms of use, compatible with CC BY (not re-read)

sites.name: Bureau of Meteorology (Australia)
sites.api: FTP/JSON products; reuse under its copyright notice
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: CC BY for most Bureau material (not re-read)

sites.name: Environment and Climate Change Canada
sites.api: MSC GeoMet (OGC API, WMS), Datamart; no key
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: Environment and Climate Change Canada Data Servers End-use Licence (open, attribution)

sites.name: MeteoSwiss
sites.owner: Swiss Federal Office of Meteorology and Climatology

sites.name: ECMWF charts and open data
sites.owner: European Centre for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (intergovernmental)
sites.stated: Its own models: IFS and AIFS (read on its open-data page).
sites.api: open data files (GRIB) and a client; charts via Open Charts
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: CC BY 4.0 with the ECMWF Terms of Use: redistribution and commercial use allowed with attribution (read)

sites.name: EUMETSAT EUMETView
sites.stated: Its own satellites: Meteosat (including the third generation: the default EUMETView layers were MTG lightning, precipitation rate and infrared), Metop (read in EUMETView and its licensing guide).
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: EUMETSAT data policy: most Meteosat imagery free with attribution; the licensing page was a script shell here
sites.reuse: yes with attribution (to confirm per product)

sites.name: MeteoAlarm
sites.owner: EUMETNET (the network of European national services)
sites.stated: Warnings from the national services themselves (EUMETNET members); for Portugal, IPMA (read in its terms and feed).
sites.api: Atom + CAP feeds per country, no key
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: terms equivalent to CC BY 4.0 with extra conditions for redistribution (read in the feed)
sites.reuse: yes with attribution and its conditions

sites.name: WMO Severe Weather Information Centre
sites.api: CAP feeds via the WMO Alert Hub

sites.name: BBC Weather
sites.owner: BBC (public broadcaster); forecast data from a commercial provider
sites.stated: The Lisbon page prints "BBC Weather in association with MeteoGroup": a partner is named, no model (pointed out by incident.meteorology@ and checked in our own copy of the page).
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: BBC terms: no reuse without permission; link and short quotation only

sites.name: meteoblue
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: all rights reserved; attribution required for the free tier

sites.name: Weather Underground
sites.stated: Its /about/data page lists "ECMWF, GFS, and NAM" as forecast input, as read by incident.meteorology@ (not read by us).

sites.name: Windy
sites.stated: Model switch on the map: ECMWF, GFS, ICON, AROME and others (product knowledge; the model list was not read in this pass). Observador's embeds name GFS and ECMWF.
sites.api: paid Point Forecast and Map Forecast APIs; free embed widget (iframe)
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: all rights reserved; embed allowed as provided

sites.name: Ventusky
sites.stated: Observador's two embeds of it request the models "gfs" and "ecmwf_hres" (read in the embed addresses).

sites.name: earth.nullschool.net
sites.stated: GFS (product knowledge; not read in this pass).
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: all rights reserved (the original code is MIT on GitHub)

sites.name: Zoom Earth
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: all rights reserved; imagery from public agencies

sites.name: Open-Meteo
sites.stated: Open data of national services, listed on its licence page: DWD (ICON), ECMWF (IFS, AIFS), Météo-France, NOAA and others, each under its own open licence (read).
sites.api: HTTP GET, no key, no sign-up
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: CC BY 4.0 for the data; the free tier is for non-commercial use

sites.name: RainViewer
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: free for personal, educational and small community use only (read on its API page)

sites.name: Blitzortung / LightningMaps
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: non-commercial; raw data only for participants (read)

sites.name: Windguru
sites.stated: Named on the page per table: GFS 13 km, GFS-Wave 16 km, IFS-HRES 9 km, IFS-WAM 9 km, ICON 7 and 13 km, WRF 3 and 9 km, Zephr-HD 2.6 km, GDPS 15 km and others, each with its run time ("init"); live readings from named local stations (seen in the rendered page).

sites.name: Aviation Weather Center data API
sites.stated: METAR and TAF as issued by each airport's meteorological office (for Lisbon, issued in Portugal).

sites.name: IPMA
sites.owner: Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera (the State's meteorological authority)
sites.stated: Its own observation network, radars and forecasters; for the automatic forecasts, "processamento estatístico das previsões de dois modelos numéricos (ECMWF e AROME)", updated twice a day from the 00 and 12 UTC runs (read on api.ipma.pt).
sites.api: api.ipma.pt open data: JSON, no key (warnings up to 3 days, daily forecast by city, hourly station observations, sea state, seismic events)
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: use allowed for personal or public purposes that are not for profit or offensive, always naming the source (read on api.ipma.pt)

sites.name: IPMA: warnings on a timeline
sites.stated: IPMA's forecasters issue the warnings; criteria are on its "Critérios de emissão" page (linked from the page; not read).

sites.name: IPMA: communiqués
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: as IPMA; its notice says copyright does not apply to communiqués

sites.name: IPMA: forecast by place, hourly
sites.stated: Automatic: statistical processing of two numerical models, ECMWF and AROME, twice a day (read on the page's own notes and on api.ipma.pt). The page says this automatic forecast may differ from the forecasters' descriptive forecast and warnings.
sites.api: daily by city in the open API; the hourly series is on the site

sites.name: IPMA: radar, satellite, stations, lightning
sites.stated: IPMA's own radars, surface stations and lightning network; Meteosat imagery from EUMETSAT (the satellite page is marked "copyright EUMETSAT/IPMA").
sites.api: station observations in the open API (read: 93 KB JSON)
sites.licence_as_we_recorded: as IPMA; imagery under its terms
sites.reuse: yes, non-commercial, with attribution; images by link

sites.name: ANEPC: notices to the population
sites.owner: Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil
sites.api: none documented; occurrences are republished by fogos.pt

sites.name: Fogos.pt / VOST Portugal
sites.stated: ANEPC's occurrence data (stated on the site).

tempo.pt (Meteored)
sites.stated: Not stated on the pages read; its articles name models and IPMA in prose.

sites.reuse: link only; no names of private people
